card.title: How to repair iPhone 11 Dead Not Charging

source.title: How to repair iPhone 11 Dead Not Charging

claims.statement: iPhone 11 that stalls at about 0.140–0.150 A after power-on and boots when the sandwich is split has cold solder under the CPU.
A CPU reball fixes it but removes factory underfill, so it is recommended for data recovery only; reliability afterwards is poor.

procedure: Split the board and see if it boots.
Reball the CPU and reassemble; recover data.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: After a CPU reball without underfill the board is fragile; do not guarantee long-term reliability.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
